profile.name: Shahroz Khan
profile.headline: I build the backend products quietly depend on: REST APIs, data pipelines and automations that stay reliable long after launch.
profile.about: I'm a Python developer based in Lahore who likes the invisible parts of software: APIs with clear contracts, schemas that hold up, and background jobs that quietly do their work. Most of what I build sits between a product team and the data it depends on.
profile.summary: At SiliconWhiz I work across an internal operations platform, an AI-powered hiring product, large-scale data extraction and cross-platform automations. I ship in a small Agile team, review code carefully, and prefer observable systems over clever ones.

projects.title: VisionIMS
projects.description: Internal management system with projects, leads, tickets, attendance, real-time chat, milestones, and role-based access control.
projects.longDescription: An internal operations platform that keeps projects, leads, tickets, attendance and team chat in one place, with role-based access control applied consistently across every module.
projects.problem: Delivery, support and attendance lived in separate spreadsheets and group chats, so status was hard to read and accountability was unclear.
projects.solution: Django and Django REST Framework model the business domain (projects, milestones, leads, tickets and attendance) behind per-role permissions, with real-time chat over WebSockets and a PostgreSQL schema designed for reporting.
contributions: Built backend APIs and business workflows across projects, leads and tickets
Implemented role-based access control for module-level permissions
Added attendance tracking and milestone management
Built real-time chat and notifications with WebSockets
challenges: Keeping permission rules consistent across every API endpoint
Modelling overlapping project, ticket and attendance data cleanly
results: One workspace replaced several spreadsheets and group chats
Permissions are enforced centrally instead of per screen

projects.title: EvaHires
projects.description: AI-powered hiring platform with candidate onboarding, resume matching, live interviews, recording, transcripts, and AI-generated evaluations.
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end hiring workflow: candidate intake, resume matching, AI-led live interviews, recording, transcription and structured evaluation, served by a FastAPI backend with a React front end and PostgreSQL.
projects.problem: Hiring teams were stitching scheduling, screening and note-taking together across disconnected tools, so candidate context was lost between each step.
projects.solution: A single workflow API connects onboarding, matching, interviews and evaluation. OpenAI and ElevenLabs power conversational interviews and transcripts, Redis handles asynchronous work, and Docker keeps environments reproducible.
contributions: Designed and built REST APIs for candidate onboarding, job management and resume matching
Integrated OpenAI and ElevenLabs for live interviews, recording and transcript generation
Modelled evaluation data and AI-generated candidate assessments in PostgreSQL
Containerised the stack with Docker and added Redis-backed async processing
Shipped React-facing features in a three-person Agile team with Git-based reviews
challenges: Coordinating long-running interview and transcription work without blocking API requests
Keeping AI-generated evaluations consistent across different interview formats
results: The hiring flow moved from disconnected tools to a single API-driven pipeline
Transcripts and evaluations are produced automatically after each interview

projects.title: Web Scraping Automation
projects.description: Reusable Selenium and BeautifulSoup scraping solutions with pagination, dynamic content handling, data cleaning, multithreading, and CSV export.
projects.longDescription: A collection of reusable extraction pipelines for dynamic websites: handling pagination, rendering, retries and cleaning, then exporting structured datasets.
projects.problem: Product and research data had to be collected by hand from sites with pagination, lazy loading and dynamic content, slowly and differently every time.
projects.solution: Reusable Selenium and BeautifulSoup pipelines handle pagination, dynamic rendering, retries and normalisation, then export clean structured data to CSV. Multithreading cuts the wall-clock time of large collections.
contributions: Built reusable extraction scripts for ecommerce, job and news sites
Handled pagination and dynamic content with Selenium
Cleaned and normalised output with BeautifulSoup and Requests
Added multithreading to speed up large collections
challenges: Keeping output schemas consistent across very different sources
results: Collections that took hours now run unattended
Every export lands in the same clean schema

projects.title: Automation & AI Integration
projects.description: Zapier and n8n workflows connecting QuickBooks, Monday.com, AI services, and automated contextual chatbot responses.
projects.longDescription: Cross-platform workflows that keep business records in sync and route incoming questions through AI services for contextual answers.
projects.problem: Customer, vendor and payment records were duplicated between QuickBooks and Monday.com, and routine questions needed a faster first response.
projects.solution: Zapier workflows synchronise QuickBooks records with Monday.com using explicit triggers and field mappings, while an n8n workflow processes incoming questions through AI services and returns contextual answers.
contributions: Designed the QuickBooks to Monday.com sync workflow, triggers and field mappings
Configured workflow logic for customers, vendors and payments
Built an n8n chatbot workflow integrating AI services
Tested edge cases and reconciled data across both systems
challenges: Mapping fields between systems with different data models
Keeping synchronisation idempotent so records do not duplicate
results: Records stay consistent across both platforms without manual entry
Routine questions are answered automatically with context
